2026-02-18 - Technical deep-dive (FF-2026-02-18-1832). Attendees: CTO, Head of InfoSec, cloud infra lead. Key points discussed:
 - Must support customer-managed keys (CMKs) in AWS KMS (alias + key policy control) for hosted key wrapping.
 - Prefer HSM-backed keys (AWS CloudHSM or Azure Dedicated HSM) for root key material; Redwood must support envelope encryption with customer CMK for data-at-rest.
 - Azure Key Vault: require HSM-protected keys (HSM-backed, purge-protection), ability to use Key Vault REST flows or managed identity.
 - GCP KMS (CMEK): customer wants CMEK support and ability to rotate keys out-of-band.
 - BYOK: two paths acceptable — importable key material (per-cloud import) or external HSM bridging (KMIP/PKCS#11) for on-prem HSMs.
 - Operational requirement: key usage audit events forwarded to their SIEM and preserved for 7 years.
 - Compliance: FIPS 140-2/140-3 evidence for HSMs + attestation required in contract.

2026-02-26 - Security sync (FF-2026-02-26-0911): asked for sample integration diagrams. Aldera wants:

 - Options for key access: (1) direct KMS calls from Redwood control plane with no plaintext key ingress, (2) deploy Redwood nodes in customer's subnet and call KMS locally via VPC endpoints (preferred).
